description: Polar H2O layer (4.5x4.5 A, 2x2x1 k) in an 18 A cell with the dipole correction (DIPOLECORR=T, Bengtsson; step placed in the largest vacuum gap). The correction energy 2*pi*m^2/Omega is +1.36 mH at 12 A and +0.89 mH at 18 A (scales as 1/Omega). Also guards the variational SCF in large vacuum (gauge alignment of theta and the vacuum mask): before 2026-09-29 Davidson+VARIATIONAL stalled 75 mH above the minimum here

subs.@PSIDYN@:
STOP=T FRIC=0.02 SAFEORTHO=T EDIFF=1.E-8
    !AUTO FRIC(-)=0.3 FACT(-)=0.97 FRIC(+)=0.3 FACT(+)=1. MINFRIC=0.02 !END
